# Pooja Dugar Edit Studio

> Video editing and design by Pooja Dugar, a fashion and lifestyle creator
> (@poojadugar_ on Instagram, @poojadugar on YouTube). She edits Instagram
> Reels and Shorts, YouTube long-form videos, Instagram carousels and graphics
> for fashion and lifestyle creators and brands, including brand reels,
> affiliate content and UGC, from raw footage to a finished, platform-ready file.

## Services and prices

- Instagram Reels (`/reels`): from ₹200 per Reel (starter edits; premium
  Reels with advanced motion graphics, sound design and colour grading are
  quoted separately). Ready in 24–48 hours.
- YouTube long-form (`/youtube`): ₹1,000 per video, with a custom thumbnail and
  Shorts clippings included. Ready in 2–3 days.
- Instagram carousels (`/carousels`): ₹200 per carousel. Ready in 24–48 hours.
- Graphics (`/graphics`): thumbnails, posters, social creatives and brand
  visuals, ₹500 per graphic. Ready in 24–48 hours.
- UGC and brand videos (`/ugc`): she shoots and edits UGC, product videos
  and Reels for fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands; shoots are quoted on
  request.
- All prices, and what Reel and YouTube editing usually cost in India:
  `/pricing`.
- Every order includes 1–2 revisions. Bulk discounts, monthly packages and
  rush delivery are available on request.

## How to book

- WhatsApp: +91 99715 72036 (the fastest way)
- Email: poojadugar.pd@gmail.com
- Send raw footage, references, brand assets, captions and preferred music;
  Pooja confirms the plan, edits, and you review and request revisions.

## Also by Pooja

- The Pooja Edit (https://thepoojaedit.in): her clothing label, pre-loved
